title: The four kinds of qatl — ss. 300, 315, 318, 321 PPC

cards.title: Qatl-i-amd (s. 300)
cards.text: Intention to kill, or to injure fatally, or knowledge of imminent danger — death as qisas; death or life as ta'zir; up to 25 years (s. 302)

cards.title: Qatl shibh-i-amd (s. 315)
cards.text: Intent to harm with a weapon or act not likely to cause death — diyat + up to 25 years (s. 316)

cards.title: Qatl-i-khata (s. 318)
cards.text: No intention — mistake of act or of fact — diyat; + 5 years if rash; + 10 years if by driving (ss. 319, 320)

cards.title: Qatl-bis-sabab (s. 321)
cards.text: No intention — an unlawful act becomes the cause of death — diyat only (s. 322)

root.title: Hurt
root.sub: pain, harm, disease, infirmity, injury, disfigurement — without death; plus other hurts (ss. 337G–337L)

children.title: Jurh
children.sub: rest of the body — jaifah / ghayr-jaifah (s. 337B)

root: Offences against property — Chapter XVII PPC
rootSub: dishonesty (s. 24) is the common mental element

title: Criminal trespass — each step adds an element

steps.title: Criminal trespass (s. 441)
steps.text: Entry on property in another's possession with intent to offend, intimidate, insult or annoy

steps.title: House-trespass (s. 442)
steps.text: + into a dwelling, place of worship or building for custody of property

steps.title: Lurking house-trespass (s. 443)
steps.text: + precautions to conceal the trespass; by night (s. 444)

steps.title: House-breaking (s. 445)
steps.text: + entry or exit by one of six modes (own passage, climbing, lock, force, unfastening…); by night (s. 446)
steps.law: theft by night — up to 14 years (s. 457)
